Every concept below is OWNED by WEB06 (usWEB06 section 2.5; persisted in PostgreSQL,
layout stored as JSONB). VIS04 introduces NO new domain concept: it reads the
ACTIVE configuration loaded by VIS01 (GET /kitchen-configurations/active) and maps
MaterialProperties and the resolved KitchenAssets to 3D rendering materials.
Only the concepts relevant to materials and textures are shown.
The WEB06 back end is the authority on these rules.
